consent.heading: Before we begin
consent.title: Consent & privacy
consent.intro: Your privacy and safety are our priority. Please take a moment to review the information below. It explains how we protect your data during the pilot.
consent.terms_text: By participating in this pilot programme, you agree to use UpSpeech in accordance with its intended purpose as a speech therapy support tool. Your usage data may be collected in anonymised form to improve the platform. You may withdraw from the pilot at any time by contacting your administrator.
consent.privacy_text: UpSpeech collects audio recordings, exercise data, and usage analytics to provide speech therapy services. Your data is stored securely, encrypted at rest and in transit. Your recordings are processed for speech analysis and clinical report generation, which involves trusted third-party AI providers (ElevenLabs for transcription and Google's Gemini for report generation) acting only on our instructions. We never sell your data, and we don't share it for any other purpose without your explicit consent. Your recordings are only used to train AI models if you separately opt in.
consent.required_hint: Please complete this step to continue

recording_controls.title: Recording controls
recording_controls.description: Use these controls to record your practice session. You can pause, resume, and add annotations as you practise.

first_run.expired_body: Invitations last 7 days. Ask {{therapist}} for a new one. Nothing is lost.
first_run.offline_body: The recording is saved on this phone. It goes to {{therapist}} as soon as you are back online.
first_run.resume_body: Everything is saved and there is nothing to repeat. Pick up here when there is a calm moment.

patient.invite_bubble: Welcome to UpSpeech, {{name}}. This is where you'll practise in between our sessions. I'll be listening on the other side!
patient.invite_title: Your voice has a place here.
patient.invite_lead: Five minutes: a companion, a question from {{therapist}}, your first recording.
patient.companion_lead: It keeps you company while you practise. It does not judge and it does not keep score.
patient.companion_hint_change: Tap the bubble to change the name.
patient.companion_name_prompt: What would you like us to call you?
patient.companion_name_hint: {{therapist}} knows you as {{full_name}}. Here you can be whoever you like.
patient.how_title: Therapy does not stay in the clinic room.
patient.how_bubble_record: You record when you want to.
patient.consent_lead: Speech changes with the situation. Short recordings help you, and help {{therapist}} see what happens outside the session. Nothing is assessed automatically.
patient.consent_record_label: Record my voice and share it with {{therapist}}
patient.consent_record_hint: Needed to record. Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} listen.
patient.consent_research_label: Help improve UpSpeech with anonymised recordings
patient.consent_research_hint: Optional. UpSpeech works fully without it.
patient.consent_already: You have already given this consent.
patient.consent_mic_hint: Your phone asks once. You record when you want to.
patient.mic_denied_body: UpSpeech only hears you if you allow it in Settings. Everything else works, and you record when you want to.
patient.record_prompt: What are you planning for this week?
patient.record_hint: Speak the way you speak. Thirty seconds is enough. You can do it again as many times as you like.
patient.record_too_short: That one was too short. Try again whenever you like.
patient.listen_lead: Self-observation: just listening is already part of the work. Nobody else hears this for now.
patient.listen_note_placeholder: Did you notice anything? Blocks, repetitions, tension… (optional)
patient.send_privacy: Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} listen. You can delete it whenever you like.
patient.home_pilot_body: It is your first recording. {{therapist}} replies here.
patient.home_next_body: A short interview about your speech, to get to know you better.

caregiver.invite_bubble: Welcome to UpSpeech, {{caregiver}}. This is where {{child}} will practise in between our sessions, with you beside them. I'll be listening on the other side!
caregiver.invite_body: Five minutes: a companion for {{child}}, a question from {{therapist}}, {{child}}'s first recording.
caregiver.invite_not_responsible: Not {{child}}'s parent or guardian? Let {{therapist}} know.
caregiver.how_title: Therapy does not stay in the clinic room.
caregiver.how_body: A few minutes at a time, whenever there is a calm moment.
caregiver.consent_body: Children speak differently at home and in the clinic. Short recordings let {{therapist}} hear {{child}} as they really are. Nothing is assessed automatically.
caregiver.consent_share: Record {{child}}'s voice and share it with {{therapist}}
caregiver.consent_share_hint: Needed to record. As {{child}}'s parent or guardian, you agree for them. Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} listen.
caregiver.consent_research: Help improve UpSpeech with anonymised recordings
caregiver.consent_research_hint: Optional. UpSpeech works fully without it.
caregiver.mic_denied_body: Turn it on in Settings when it suits you. {{child}} can still pick a companion and see the plan.
caregiver.handover_body: {{child}} picks a companion. Then ask {{child}} how their day was, and let your therapist know by sending them the recording.
caregiver.pick_customise_later: You can change how I look later, in Settings.
caregiver.send_note_placeholder: e.g. After school is harder; mornings are easier.
caregiver.send_hint: Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} can listen. {{clinic}} usually replies within 2 working days.
caregiver.send_sent: Sent. {{therapist}} will listen and reply here.
caregiver.home_intake_body: Tell {{therapist}} about {{child}}: a few questions, a few minutes.
caregiver.reply_for_you_first: For you first, then one for {{child}}
caregiver.consent_mic_hint: Your phone asks once. You record when it suits you both.
caregiver.pick_lead: Pick a friend to practise with. They never judge and they never keep score.
caregiver.record_hint: Ask {{child}} how their day was and let them answer in their own words. Thirty seconds is enough.
caregiver.listen_lead: Play {{child}}'s answer back. Nobody else hears it for now.
caregiver.send_lead: Let {{therapist}} know how {{child}}'s day went. {{therapist}} listens and replies here.
caregiver.send_privacy: Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} listen. You can delete it whenever you like.
